description: MantleOS is the phone app for a Mantle brain, the self-hosted AI memory you run on your own server. Chat with your assistant, search everything, notes, pages, tasks, journal, files and events. No Mantle server yet? Enter https://review.mantleos.io on the first screen and sign in with any email and password; it holds fictional data and is read only.
whatsNew: Jackdaw is now MantleOS. The app has a new name, the MantleOS sun icon, and one MantleOS colour theme that matches mantleos.io. Your saved theme, logins and data carry over.
